name: stock-control
description: Stock Control PWA with optional Firebase backend. Dev dependencies are only for tests and emulators; the app itself has no build step.

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-stock-control "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/rules.test.mjs tests/backend.test.mjs"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:logic && npm run test:rules
